SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 7468
Date 16 - 8 - 36

FILE NO. D 7468

August 14 36.

Edward L. Faupel, Esq.,
United States Marshal for China,
Shanghai.

Sir,

I have the honour to refer to your
letter dated July 17, 1936, in regard to one
Vincent Masson, and to inform you that no person
of this name has arrived here from America during
the past few weeks. The name has been noted and
should Masson disembark at Shanghai at a future
date, a further communication will be addressed
to you.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

〔此处转录不清〕

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section 2, Special Branch
REPORT

File No. [Original-POLICE]
S. B. REGISTRY
No. S. 2 D. / 468
Date August 14, 1936.

Subject (in full) Enquiry from U. S. Marshal for China re Vincent Masson.

Made by D.S. Jones Forwarded by J. Byrne LSI

With reference the attached letter dated July 17, 1936
from the United States Marshal for China concerning the
whereabouts of one Vincent Masson, who was expected to leave
California for Shanghai, I have to state that no person of
this name has figured on the passenger lists of vessels which
have arrived here from North America during the past few weeks.
The name has been noted, however, and should Masson ever
disembark at Shanghai a further report conveying this information
will be submitted.

D. S. Jones
D. S.

DBR
14/8

D.C. (Crime & Special Branches)

（印：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER 14 AUG. 1936 CRIME BRANCH）

特别科登记处
编号：S. 2 D. / 468
日期：1936年8月14日。

事由（全称） 美国驻华法警就文森特·马松（Vincent Masson）一事进行的查询。

由 D.S. 琼斯（D.S. Jones）呈报 经 J. 伯恩（J. Byrne）警长转呈

关于附呈的1936年7月17日美国驻华法警来信，该信涉及据称预计将从加利福尼亚前往上海的文森特·马松（Vincent Masson）的下落，本人须陈述，在过去几周内抵达本埠的来自北美的船只乘客名单中，并未出现此人的名字。然而，该姓名已予记录，若马松将来在上海登陆，将提交进一步报告通报此信息。

D. S. 琼斯
D. S.

DBR
14/8

副警务处长（刑事与特别科）

（印章：副警务处长 1936年8月14日 刑事科）

DEPARTMENT OF JUSTICE
U. S. MARSHAL FOR CHINA
SHANGHAI, CHINA
July 17, 1936.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTR
B. D. 7468
... 7 ...）

Commissioner of Police,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
Shanghai, China.

Sir;

An inquiry has been made to this office
regarding the where-abouts of one Vincent Masson,
who is reported to have left, or is expecting to
leave, California for Shanghai.

The report indicates that he skipped out.
of California without paying rent and other bills.
Also that he opened mail, taking money addressed to
people other than himself, addressed to the place
which he previously had rented.

If you should subsequently find that this
man is in Shanghai, it will be greatly appreciated
if you will inform this office.

Respectfully yours,

Edward L. Faupel
Edward L. Faupel
United States Marshal
for China.

ELF-A

美国驻华法警
中国上海
1936年7月17日。

（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处
特别科登记处
B. D. 7468
... 7 ...）

警务处处长，
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
中国上海。

先生：

本办公室收到一项查询，涉及文森特·马松（Vincent Masson）的下落，据报此人已离开或正计划从加利福尼亚前往上海。

报告指出，他在未支付租金及其他账单的情况下逃离了加利福尼亚。此外，他还拆阅寄给他人、但寄至他此前租赁地址的邮件，并从中取走钱款。

若您随后发现此人在上海，如能通知本办公室，将不胜感激。

此致
敬礼

爱德华·L·福佩尔
美国驻华法警

ELF-A
